formal_entry.environment: Explicit offline model HTTP/SSE + managed gh executable; actual formal binary, existing OpenAI adapter, Source/Client/SQL/Native/CodingToolBundle/Outbox, no paid/live services.

business_assertions: Actual main read/settings/models/prompts/SQL and worker own-ticket/trigger/prompt/Source/transcript calls occur through formal executable and actual HTTP/SSE adapter; no internal Plan serialized as success.
Missing offset defaults to zero; unknown forged ticket_id rejected before handler; worker global/foreign ticket, defaults, settings and models reads refused; no raw model credential exposed.
Long Chinese/emoji Source body is bounded at initial delivery and read in full; source page continuation is session-scoped and does not repeat CLI GET; main cannot reuse worker Source snapshot.

Original JSONL genuinely contains private reasoning, while readable transcript omits it and keeps public tool invocation name/canonical ID/raw arguments; no ensure/prepare/wake or second conversation store.
Actual result.txt write, ready report, SQL ticket end and two marker replies (ack/result) after reads; stopped in-flight CLI is joined before lease release, no file/result reply/completion invented.
Existing14 formal boot/authorization/control/retry/recovery/duplicate tests remain exercised with shared input renderer.
explicit_adaptations: Eight existing disjoint primitive/null metadata unions retained. Only the two read tools project Zod OUTPUT required offset into INPUT optional offset with default0; all numeric/other constraints retained, no kernel validator/default changes.
Same CI check name/status string conclusion precedes null, proved by original executable counterexample; no case/assertion removed and no global collation/V8 migration.
Public Native tool_calls mapped to tool-call content blocks, preserving raw arguments including malformed JSON; private provider envelopes and reasoning omitted.
Existing settings/Prompt identity value stringify reused at read/save boundary, not a global JSON/string type migration.

commands.command: unset XH_GH_LIVE; cargo test --locked -p xharness-superagent-core -p xharness-superagent -p xharness-agent -p xharness-host -p xharness-core -p xharness-provider-openai -p xharness-coding-tools -p xharness-platform -p xharness-gh --all-targets --features xharness-superagent/conformance --no-fail-fast

regression_scope.aggregate_count_omitted: Do not count nested subprocess result rows, repeats or capability early returns as distinct product checks.
regression_scope.existing_cancelled_language_tests: Unmodified historical workspace regression only, not newly accepted business language work.
regression_scope.prior_wzu_failures_not_cleared: Legacy Feishu dedicated UID/egress deployment assertions were not rerun/cleared by this selected regression; no host/user/firewall/service changes.

current_head_ci: Inspect the precise newly published PR head; prior green is not current-code sign-off.

failures_retained.failure: Session.events exposes LoggedEvent, not SessionEvent; compile error corrected without suppression.
Strict Clippy match simplified for deliberate disabled-source schema-default projection.
Original CI check ordering counterexample: null vs string conclusion. Fixed product sorting, retained expected values.
Existing JsValue is not Deserialize; used existing conversion API instead of new global type work.
Strict Clippy redundant String conversion removed.

Actual formal reads rejected for missing offset by output JSONSchema; responder then panicked on missing continuation and cleanup. Fixed explicit read input default projection; no success fixture injected.
New transcript test constructed integer instead of existing Revision newtype; corrected test construction.

Whole context module import needs unrelated SDK graph absent from conformance. Execute byte-unchanged standalone transcriptEntry with Node built-in TS erasure and record original-function hash; no dependency/stubs.

remaining_scope: Seven main registrations: ticket_note, eval/eval_read/eval_decide, settings_save/policy_sync/prompts_save; inferred admission and configuration side effects.
Full Source links/reply-to context, GitHub PR ownership/report and event branches, Feishu conversations/attachments/replies and multi-source.
Prompt save previews, seen-version transitions, full configuration/model management API and UI.
Worker stop/background/subagent settling, full slots/timeouts/retry and every crash/outbox cut.
Independent deploy/health/backup/restore/rollback and necessary release regression; no auto-merge or production deployment.
